DENMARK, LEGOLAND – NEW FOR 2027!

Go Beyond discovers the magical brick kingdom

Friday 8th – Tuesday 12th October

What's to get excited about!

Did you know that the small town of Billund in Denmark has a population of just 7,500 yet has its own airport? And the reason why? It is the birthplace of LEGO and homes one of Scandinavia’s most visited tourist attractions in LEGOLAND!

Go Beyond are delighted to offer this 4-night long weekend break to Billund, a real treat for anyone who has a love for the most popular toy in the world. It will begin with a flight from London directly to Billund in central Denmark, where we will pick up our minibus and take the short drive to the Sdr. Omme Kro & Hotel. After a good night’s sleep, we have three full, fun-packed days ahead of us which will start with a visit to LEGO House. LEGO House is a LEGO lover’s dream! It’s a world of creativity where we will get to explore interactive zones, build our own creations, and experience the story behind the LEGO brick.

Following this, will be a full day at the original LEGOLAND theme park itself. Situated next to the original factory, whilst there we will be free to explore the attraction at our own leisure. We can marvel at all the incredible miniature replicas on display and enjoy the coasters and rides that are all included with our tickets.

Our third day will take us to WOW Park, an outdoor adventure park filled with treetop adventures, giant Tarzan swings, a water world and underground caves! After all that we will be ready to return home for a well-earned rest!

Where you'll be staying...

The Sdr. Omme Kro & Hotel is a small hotel ideally located so that wherever we need to get to, whether that be the airport or the attractions, we’ll be less than half an hour in the minibus. All rooms have their own private bathrooms and there’s free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel also.

Food, glorious food!

We shall be taking advantage of the hotel’s restaurant and enjoying breakfast there each day before we set off. For convenience, tasty packed lunches will be organised for when we’re out and about. Evening meals will either be taken at the hotel or possibly at a local restaurant.

Travel

We will meet at a London airport and you will be supported on our direct, return flights to and from Billund in central Denmark . We shall be hiring a minibus on our arrival and this shall provide our mode of transportation for all of our daily activities.

Itineray

Day 1 – Flight to Billund, minibus to hotel and settle in

Day 2 – Day at LEGO House

Day 3 – Day at LEGOLAND

Day 4 – Day at WOW Park

Day 5 – Travel back to the UK

Your holiday will include the following:

  • 4 night accommodation and all meals provided
  • All entrance fees to all activities and sites.
  • Airport transfers and transport in and around Billund.
  • Return flights from London to Billund, accompanied and supported by our Go Beyond team.
  • A ratio of 2 guests to 1 Go Beyond support staff member.
  • Support from our Go Beyond team during the holiday.

Accessiblility and Inclusion

Inclusion is important to us so we strive, whenever possible, to make our holidays accessible to all.

If you wish to discuss your specific access requirement for any of our holidays, please contact us at your earliest convenience and we will do everything we can to welcome you to the Go Beyond Holidays experience.
